items.scope: Okta issues only.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
Digi branded products and services only.
All WatchDog products.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
ABB issues only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
JetBrains products only.
Synology issues only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Netskope products and services.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
ELAN issues only.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities identified in Cribl products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Cribl that are not in another CNA’s scope.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.
Siemens issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by Patchstack and Patchstack Bug Bounty program unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Products, services, and solutions developed by Canon EMEA, Canon USA Inc., and those from IRIS, NT-ware, Onyx Graphics Inc., and Therefore Corporation, which are not under the Canon Brand.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Yandex issues only.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Vulnerabilities in any Google Cloud developed product and not under the scope of another CNA.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
Supported Milestone XProtect products.
All Network Optix products, including https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness and https://www.networkoptix.com/powered-by-nx.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
Omron Group companies’ Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Social Systems, Device & Module Solutions issues only.
Bizerba products only.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
